name: Nasus
notes: Soul Eater is life steal only (a heal), it never reduces the dummy's effective health, so it is not modeled in this damage fight.
Wither is never cast: its slow and attack-speed cripple only matter against a target that moves or attacks back, which the stationary dummy never does.

Fury of the Sands is cast at t=0: it starts its 0.5s-interval, 15s aura DoT on the dummy immediately, and halves Siphoning Strike's cooldown for its duration; the bonus health/resist/size are defensive-only and not modeled.

Siphoning Strike is cast the instant it is off cooldown and unarmed: casting it arms the next basic attack (no direct damage on cast) and resets the attack timer to one windup away, matching 'resets Nasus' basic attack timer'; the empowered attack's bonus damage lands with that attack and the cooldown then starts (post-effect), halved while Fury of the Sands is active.

Siphoning Strike's bonus damage is read as base (crit-affected, per the wiki's explicit crit note) plus a flat, non-crit amount equal to the assumed permanent Siphoning Strike stack count; the bin's extra '1xad' term in its total-damage formula is read as the tooltip folding in the attack's own AD (already dealt by the engine's normal attack), not a second AD scaling, since the wiki's own leveling text lists no AD ratio.
Because the dummy never dies, Siphoning Strike's permanent stacks cannot grow in-fight; a fixed pre-fight stack count is assumed (see 'assumed').

Spirit Fire is cast on cooldown throughout the fight: its initial hit lands 0.25s after cast, then its lingering zone deals 10 ticks at 0.5s intervals (matching the tooltip's 10x-per-tick total) over its 5s duration, and applies its percent armor shred for that duration plus its stated 1s lingering.

The engine's shred slot is a single flat number under abilities.Q even though Spirit Fire (E) is the ability that actually shreds armor in-game; because the engine reads that one value directly rather than by rank, the value used is Spirit Fire's rank-5 armor shred (50%), matching E's rank at the fight's default level 16 where Q and E are both maxed.
Mana is not modeled: none of Nasus' costs are large enough relative to a single-target 8-15s level 16 fight to plausibly stop a cast.

assumed.why: a stationary dummy never dies to grant new Siphoning Strike stacks, so a fixed late-game permanent stack count (100) is assumed for the fight
the wiki description says Spirit Fire's zone ticks 'each second' but its own tooltip total (10x the listed per-tick value) only matches a 0.5s tick rate over the 5s duration, so 10 ticks is used
Spirit Fire's armor reduction is stated to last its 5s zone duration plus an extra 1s of lingering, so 6s is used

the engine reads a single flat shred percentage rather than one by ability rank, so Spirit Fire's rank-5 armor shred (50%, NasusE.ArmorShredPercent at max rank) is used, matching E's rank at the fight's default level 16
